title: Fresh Mint Sauce
summary: Finely chopped mint and parsley stirred into olive oil with lemon juice and garlic.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Chop the herbs
steps.text: Chop the mint and parsley finely with a sharp knife so they stay bright green.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Put the herbs in the jug with the oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper and stir well.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Leave for 10 min so the flavours blend.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Stir again and spoon over sliced roast lamb.

tips: Dry the herbs well after washing.
Chop the herbs shortly before serving for the best colour.
Add a pinch of sugar for a sweeter sauce.
storage: Best on the day; keep covered in the fridge for up to 1 day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
